LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.0.d: Retains Hamstringer's critical value, stacking bleed, six pulses, 30% movement reduction and Vulnerability interaction. Branches count only your ordinary critical hits that actually damage enemies still carrying your own Hamstring bleed. Another caster's bleed, abilities and secondary hits do not count. Progress stays with the item; no free abilities.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.1.d: Two ordinary critical hits within 5 seconds on the same enemy still carrying your Hamstring bleed add 3 base slash damage to the second hit, once per 8 seconds. Changing victims restarts the count. Noncritical hits neither count nor extend the window; bleeding itself cannot trigger the slash. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.2.d: Ordinary critical hits on two different enemies within 6 seconds, each carrying your Hamstring bleed when its hit settles, send a pulse from the second impact. Deal 50 base damage each to up to two other enemies within 5 cells and clear sight who still carry your bleed, once per 10 seconds. Never repeats the original victim or spreads to an enemy without your bleed. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.3.d: After Follow the Cut deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.4.d: After Follow the Cut deals actual bonus damage, deal 25 base damage to one other enemy within 4 cells and clear sight who carries your Hamstring bleed, once per 8 seconds. Filter by your own bleed before choosing the nearest victim; never hits the original victim again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.5.d: After Cross the Wounds deals actual bonus damage, heal 40 base injury points on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 10 seconds. Hitting multiple victims aids once; with no eligible injured ally, nothing is redirected to you. Base rewards: healing 40.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_Hamstringer.nodes.6.d: Enemies actually damaged by Cross the Wounds each receive a wound-debt mark for 5 seconds, with two victims maximum. Your later ordinary hit consumes that victim's mark for 50 base damage. Abilities, bleeding and secondary hits cannot spend it; the pulse cannot spend a mark it just created. Base rewards: damage 50.
